item.title: Balfour Beatty shares pop after lifting guidance
item.summary: Balfour Beatty shares popped higher on Wednesday after the group raised its full-year guidance on the back of a strong first half, with a turnaround in its US business and booming demand for power transmission work driving a sharp rise in profit.
